title: Letter grade
prompt: Turn a score into a letter: 90 or more is "A", 80 or more is "B", 70 or more is "C", anything lower is "F".
hints: Check the biggest number first, using if, then elif, then else.

docs.name: if condition:
docs.what: Runs the indented lines below it only when the condition is true. elif and else add more branches.
Comparisons. Each gives true or false.
